depiction.primary_object: tilted pencil with a filled top above a horizontal bar
depiction.composition: diagonal pencil angled down-left over a solid horizontal rectangle

readings.meaning: sign a document or signature line

ambiguity: Often used in rich-text toolbars to represent text highlight color or border color because of the thick bar beneath the pencil.

modifier_semantics.meaning: writing surface, signature line, or underline

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a pencil over a horizontal line, universally recognized as writing, signing on a line, or editing. It fits many everyday tasks involving signatures, handwriting, creative writing, and stationery, though generic 'edit/update' tasks are better served by icons showing the object being updated.
